blacklistabilityReview.evidence: At Ethereum block 26224772 (2026-10-19), the sole catalogued deployment is the Ethereum upgradeable proxy 0x4f827a63755855cdf3e8f3bcd20265c833f15033 (100% of supply; material). The EIP-1967 implementation is Sourcify-verified UmbrellaStakeToken 0x75e8ac0c063b6966e2a9954adedf39bde9370197, asset() is canonical GHO 0x40d16fc0246ad3160ccc09b8d0d3a2cd28ae6c2f, owner() is Aave Umbrella 0xD400fc38ED4732893174325693a63C30ee3881a8 and paused()=false; the ProxyAdmin 0xde9f8379a5a972100d0373103a849e8abdf56a9a is owned by Aave Governance V3 Level-1 Executor 0x5300a1a15135ea4dc7ad5a167152c01efc9b192a. The implementation exposes no blacklist, denylist, freeze, seizure, forced-transfer or arbitrary-holder burn selector. pause()/unpause() are onlyOwner and _update is whenNotPaused, so the owner can halt all holder share transfers; the Umbrella owner's DEFAULT_ADMIN and PAUSE_GUARDIAN roles are held by non-zero Aave-governance Safes. This is a direct global pause (direct Possible under the FreezeWatch decision procedure, docs/blacklist-tracker.md), not a holder-targeted freeze. slash() is permissionless deficit coverage under the configured GHO slashing config and cannot target an individual holder; rescue functions reach only unaccounted contract balances. Parent GHO's 2026-10-19 assessment is Upstream: pinned drawn GSM debt plus issuer-controlled Horizon collateral establishes at least 53.53115652% qualifying debt-weighted exposure, even before Core/Lido collateral contributions; the 100% GHO reserve claim therefore adds inherited issuer/custodian exposure, while stkGHO remains direct Possible because its own global pause takes precedence.

oracleRisk.summary: stkGHO is a slashable Aave Umbrella safety-module receipt and has no borrower-owned collateral positions or token-level liquidation oracle. Its underlying GHO exposure inherits the external Aave reserve-oracle and bad-debt risks reviewed on the parent asset.

branchApplicability.reviewer: OpenAI Codex external-b oracle applicability review
branchApplicability.rationale: Aave documents Umbrella StakeTokens as ERC-4626 vaults whose redeemable underlying value changes when the automated deficit-cover mechanism slashes stake, and the implementation values the stake-token underlying when determining coverage. This creates a price-sensitive top-level stkGHO exchange-rate and slashing authority. stkGHO depositors do not open GHO borrower positions, so no collateral-liquidation branch rows apply; the underlying GHO parent carries its separate Aave reserve-oracle exposure.
